build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a jar, ball, and floor bars using creator_lib
create_dynamic_objects: create dynamic jar and ball objects with configurable positions and scales in a PHYRE scene
add_static_bars: add static bar objects to create floor walls on either side of a jar
update_task_relationships: update task to require the ball touching a target wall using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to PRE_TWO_BALLS for the PHYRE task
